bootstrap.about_before: Le khasi lilandelela yonke inkqubo yokuqala yendawo eyodwa — umngcele olele, ukudlula kwabantu ababalulekile, ibhodi yokhetho lokuqala yesikhashana, nezikhungo ezihlanganisayo. Ukubuyisela kuphinda kusetshenzise imishini efanayo lapho uhulumeni elahleka:
bootstrap.board_rest: Kuze kube yilapho isishayamthetho sikhona, uhlelo luqala ngokusebenza njengebhodi lokhetho lusebenzisa izinto ezimiselwe zomthethosisekelo (ivoti elihleleke ngokulingana, izikhathi zeminyaka eyi-5, izihlalo ezi-5–9 ngesifunda). Ibhodi elizimele elifanele liyalinqanda lapho ukuphatha kuhlangana.
bootstrap.board_strong: Ibhodi lokhetho lokuqala — likesikhashana, ukuthathelwa indawo kulindile.
bootstrap.dormant_note: Le ndawo ilandelelwa kodwa ayikadluli abantu bayo ababalulekile.
bootstrap.intro: Yonke indawo iqala ngokulela — umngcele kumephu, ulindile. Lapho abahlali abavumelekiwe abanele behlala ngaphakathi, ukhetho lokuqala luqala futhi izikhungo zihlanganiseka ngokulandelana okugcwele. Abantu abanele → ukhetho lokuqala → ukuphatha okugcwele.

disintermediation.chain_body: Wonke umvoti wakudala uphendula ngqo ezingeni elingaphezulu, futhi uhulumeni womhlali wonke uvuselelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo — uba yingxenye yawo wonke amaningi asalayo ngasikhathi sinye. Ikhala lishintsha ngomzuzu yokuba ukunqamuka kuqale; akekho obhalisela kabusha lutho.

Imithetho yesigaba esinqamukile ayinyamalali: ihlangana nomthetho waleyo ndawo isalayo. Bonke abangaphakathi bavuma, izinga elingaphezulu livuma, bese imithetho ihlangana.

restoration.about: Ukubuyisela futhi kuyindlela yokuseka — ukumisa umhlaba kusetshenziswa irekhodi ekhona kufana nokwakha kabusha. Ukukhetho kwezinga kudlulisela ekukhethweni kokuqala kokuseka; izinga 3 libuyela ekusekeni kwendawo yegunya. Ukwakha kabusha kungumgaqo, hhayi isimo sokugcina: indawo ibuyela ekuzibusa ngomzuzu lapho uhulumeni obuyiselwe uhleliwe futhi uqinisekiswa.

restoration.cascade_reuse: Ukukhetho kokwakha kabusha kusetshenziswa imishini yokukhetho kokuqala —
restoration.cond_captured_body: Izikhungo zikhona kodwa azisaphenduli kubavoti bawo — zithathwe, zaphoqeleka, noma zavalwa ngokwemithetho.
restoration.cond_countermanded_body: Izinqumo zomthetho ziyavinjwa noma zithathwa igunya elingenasisekelo somthethosisekelo — uhulumeni uyachithwa ngokungaphambani nomthethosisekelo.
restoration.cond_destroyed_body: Izikhungo azisasekho — inhlekelele, impi, noma ukuwa.
restoration.conditions_body: Ukutholwa kusekelwe ubufakazi futhi kungabuyezwa inkantolo — akukona ukushintsha kwelungu elilodwa. Isimo esimemezwe asivuli lutho kuze kube yilapho inkantolo ikuqinisekisa.
restoration.declare_body: Ukumemezela akuvuli lutho ngokwakho — inkantolo kufanele iqinisekise isimo ohlelweni lokubuyekeza oluhambisana nakho ngaphambi kokuba uhlelo luqale (Art. VI §2).
restoration.def_body_2: hulumeni — hhayi ophethe isihlalo njengamanje, hhayi owamandla kakhulu, hhayi okuthandwa yiketshala labo lemiyalelo. Ngesikhathi sokubuyisela, ukhetho, izikhathi zomsebenzi, kanye nezinkantolo ezisasebenza ngeke ziphazamuriswe.
restoration.def_citation: Amandla okuvikela avikela uhulumeni osemthethweni kakhulu.
restoration.dormant_rest: Ukuhamba phansi kungowokuzilolongela; isigameko esimemezwe futhi siqinisekiswe inkantolo siyasivula.
restoration.dormant_strong: Imode yokubuyisela ilele — ayikho isimo sokuvula esitholakele.
restoration.intro: Uma uhulumeni olungile ukhishwa isigaba, ubanjwe, noma ucephuke, ukubuyisela kuyaqala — nokwakha kabusha ukhetho kuhla ngezinga ezintathu, yililona ngalinye livuleka kuphela lapho elingaphezulu lungakwazi ukusebenza. Ukutholwa kuqala uhlelo lokwakha kabusha ukhetho. Le khasi lingowokuzilolongela.
restoration.legit_body: Uma kunezinhlangano ezingaphezu kweyodwa ezithi ziyihulumeni, izinto ezintathu zinquma: kuncishiswe ukwephulwa kwezincazelo, kulinganiswe izifiso ngokufanayo, kubuswe ngendlela ephumelelayo.
restoration.no_finding: Icase lokubuyekeza elihambisana nakho alinayo okutholwe yinkantolo ngomthethosisekelo okwamanje — ukuqinisekisa kuzalawe kuze kube yilapho kunalo.

union_formation.founding_body: Umele isishayamthetho uphakamisa inyunyana ekamelweni lakhe; iningi elikhethekile lakamelweni livula ukuvota kokuqinisekisa okulandeleka ngenhla.
union_formation.founding_note: Lo mhlaba usehlanganiswe ngaphansi koMhlaba, ngakho ayikho inyunyana eyak히wa manje. Leli sususa semnyango simthetho futhi silungele imihlaba yesikhathi esizayo kanye nezinyunyana ezincane.
union_formation.intro: Izindawo ezimbili noma ezingaphezulu ezizimele zakha inyunyana ngokuhlola lapho izilungiselelo nezikhungo zazo zihlukana khona, zivumelane nenani elilodwa elihlanganyelwe kulokho okuhlukile, futhi ziqinisekise ngeningi elikhethekile — labantu abafisayo kanye nezindawo zegunya zomvoti zenyunyana. Ukuphuma kufana nokungena: azikho iminyango eyodwa.
union_formation.mirror_body: Ukuhlanganisa inyunyana esikhona kusebenzisa inqubo efanayo yokungena, kanti ukuphuma kudinga amaningi elifanayo elikhethekile. Inqubo yokungena nenqubo yokuphuma zifana — azikho iminyango eyodwa.
union_formation.no_siblings: Azikho izindawo eziseduze ezihlanganyela umzali nowakho — inyunyana esungulwayo idinga okungenani abalingani ababili abazimele.

union_formation.process_closed: Le nqubo i-{state} — iminyango yayo ivalele.
union_formation.proposing_requires: Ukuphakamisa kudinga isihlalo sesishayamthetho samanje. Noma ubani angabuka inqubo; umele isihlalo kuphela ongayivula.
union_formation.signin_hint: Ngena ngesihlalo sesishayamthetho samanje ukuze urekhode inhlolovo, uvule ukuvota kokuvuma kwekamelo lakho, noma uqedele.
union_formation.title: Ukubumbana kwenyunyana
